verses.text: For the choirmaster. According to Gittith. A Psalm of David. O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth! You have set Your glory above the heavens.

xrefs.text: O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth!
Blessed be the name of the LORD both now and forevermore.
Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.
Let them praise the name of the LORD, for His name alone is exalted; His splendor is above the earth and the heavens.
For Your loving devotion reaches to the heavens, and Your faithfulness to the clouds.

verses.text: From the mouths of children and infants You have ordained praise on account of Your adversaries, to silence the enemy and avenger.

xrefs.text: “Do You hear what these children are saying? they asked. “Yes, Jesus answered. “Have you never read: ‘From the mouths of children and infants You have ordained praise’
But He said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is perfected in weakness. Therefore I will boast all the more gladly in my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may rest on me.
But those who wait upon the LORD will renew their strength; they will mount up with wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not faint.
“Be still and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted over the earth.”
But God chose the foolish things of the world to shame the wise; God chose the weak things of the world to shame the strong.

verses.text: When I behold Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, the moon and the stars, which You have set in place—

xrefs.text: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
By the word of the LORD the heavens were made, and all the stars by the breath of His mouth.
He made the moon to mark the seasons; the sun knows when to set.
The heavens are Yours, and also the earth. The earth and its fullness You founded.
Great are the works of the LORD; they are pondered by all who delight in them.

verses.text: what is man that You are mindful of him, or the son of man that You care for him?

xrefs.text: What is man that You should exalt him, that You should set Your heart upon him,
O LORD, what is man, that You regard him, the son of man that You think of him?
But somewhere it is testified in these words: “What is man that You are mindful of him, or the son of man that You care for him?
Put not your trust in princes, in mortal man, who cannot save.
“Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, because He has visited and redeemed His people.

verses.text: You made him a little lower than the angels; You crowned him with glory and honor.

xrefs.text: You made him a little lower than the angels; You crowned him with glory and honor
But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels, now crowned with glory and honor because He suffered death, so that by the grace of God He might taste death for everyone.

Then God said, “Let Us make man in Our image, after Our likeness, to rule over the fish of the sea and the birds of the air, over the livestock, and over all the earth itself and every creature that crawls upon it.”
For surely it is not the angels He helps, but the descendants of Abraham.
but emptied Himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in human likeness.

verses.text: You made him ruler of the works of Your hands; You have placed everything under his feet:

xrefs.text: God blessed them and said to them, “Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the earth and subdue it; rule over the fish of the sea and the birds of the air and every creature that crawls upon the earth.”

Then God said, “Let Us make man in Our image, after Our likeness, to rule over the fish of the sea and the birds of the air, over the livestock, and over all the earth itself and every creature that crawls upon it.”
Then Jesus came to them and said, “All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to Me.
and placed everything under his feet.” When God subjected all things to him, He left nothing outside of his control. Yet at present we do not see everything subject to him.
And God put everything under His feet and made Him head over everything for the church,

xrefs.text: The man gave names to all the livestock, to the birds of the air, and to every beast of the field. But for Adam no suitable helper was found.

xrefs.text: For the choirmaster. According to Gittith. A Psalm of David. O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth! You have set Your glory above the heavens.
Can you fathom the deep things of God or discover the limits of the Almighty?
How many are Your works, O LORD! In wisdom You have made them all; the earth is full of Your creatures.
“There is none like the God of Jeshurun, who rides the heavens to your aid, and the clouds in His majesty.
